'''DaJuan Summers''' is a student at [[Georgetown University]] in [[Washington, DC]], and a starting [[small forward]] on their [[Georgetown Hoyas basketball]] team. He has declared his eligibility for the 2009 [[NBA Draft]], where he is considered a late first-round prospect.<ref>[http://news.yahoo.com/s/ap/20090330/ap_on_sp_co_ne/bkc_georgetown_summers_nba_draft;_ylt=AjjBFcXy07EI5.upcjmRQ7kLMxIF Georgetown's Summers Declares for Draft] Yahoo Sports, March 30, 2009</ref>

Summers is a native of [[Baltimore, Maryland]] and played with the Cecil Kirk [[Amateur Athletic Union]] teams growing up in the [[Mt. Royal, Baltimore]] section of Baltimore City. He is a 2006 graduate of the [[McDonogh School]], an elite private school, in [[Owings Mills, Maryland|Owings Mills]], [[Maryland]], where he averaged 20 points and 11 rebounds as a junior and was named the Baltimore City Player of the Year.  In addition, he was one of only 21 high school players selected to participate in the [[2006]] Jordan All-American Classic.{{ref|jordan}}
